records.text: United States Marshals Service sources said marshals were sent on a wild goose chase on the day Charlie Kirk was killed.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep nPhCKwJ6ye8)

appearances.snippet: They were, my sources at the U.S. Marshals were saying they were basically sent on a wild goose chase that day.

verification.notes: The claim rests on unnamed U.S. Marshals sources, and current-source searches found no public Marshals statement, operational record, or independent corroboration of the alleged diversion. It is resolved as unverifiable pending attributable evidence.

conveyance.original_source: private communications with U.S. Marshals Service sources
